data.text:
M/S Nirma Ltd.And Ors vs State And Anr. (2024:Rj-Jd:47115) on 
20 November, 2024 
Author: Farjand Ali
Bench: Farjand Ali
[2024:Rj-Jd:47115]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
 S.B. Criminal Misc(Pet.) No. 3017/2013
1. M/s. Nirma Limited, having its registered office at Nirma
House, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad 380009, Gujarat, through its
Authorised Signatory. Shishital Kirkbhai shethe
2. Dr. Kailashnandan Pathak S/o Chandraball
Pathak, Nominee of M/s.Nirma Limited, resident of 207, Arham
Apartment, Opposite Gulista Ground, Waghawadi Road,
Bhavnagar. 
3. Tej Singh Rawat S/o Kalu Singh Rawat, Owner -
M/s. Devnarayan Kirana Store, Gyangarh Bus Stand, Tehsil
Mandal, District Bhilwara, Rajasthan
4. Smt.Kanwaljeet Kaur W/o Pritam Singh Dua, Owner - M/s. 
Satguru Agency, 18 Chang Chitar Road, Beawar, District Ajmer,
Rajasthan. 
5. Smt.Rajendra Kaur W/o Gurucharan Singh, Owner - M/s.
Gurukrupa Agencies, 18 Chang Chitar Road, Beawar, District
Ajmer, Rajasthan. 
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
1 . State of Rajasthan through Public Prosecutor. 
2. Designated Officer (Food Safety) cum Chief
 Medical and Health Officer, Bhilwara. 
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Sunil Beniwal
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Rajpurohit, Dy.G.A.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Farjand Ali
Order 20/11/2024
1.  The misc. petition has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners aggrieved by the order dated 22.01.2013 whereby the learned Additional District Magistrate, Bhilwara had directed to institute a proceeding under Sections 26 and 52 of the Food [2024:RJ-JD:47115] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-3017/2013]
M/S Nirma Ltd.And Ors vs State And Anr. (2024:Rj-Jd:47115) on 20 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145468750/
1 Safety and Standard Act, 2006. Notices have been issued to them and that is under assail before this Court. 
2. After arguing to some extent, it is felt appropriate to direct to the petitioners to appear before the ADM, Bhilwara and to submit a detailed objection regarding continuation of the proceeding against him. As per him, no case is made out against the petitioners for even proceeding further in the matter in light of the provision contained under 3(I)(k) where the word Food Additive has been defined. Upon receiving the objection on behalf of the petitioners, it would be imperative upon the learned ADM, Bhilwara to consider the same in light of the spirit of law and the connotation made in this regard in the statute book itself and he would pass a reasoned speaking order which must reflect consideration of the submission made at the instance of the petitioner. 
3. Accordingly, the instant criminal misc. petition as well as stay petition is disposed of. 
4. The needful shall be done within a period of two months after filing of the objection. 
5. Needless to say, the petitioners are not precluded from approaching this Court again if any order averse to their interest is passed. 
6. In the meantime, no coercive measure shall be taken against them. 
(FARJAND ALI),J 47-Samvedana/-
